## Install the .NET SDK

If you do not have __.NET SDK__ installed on your machine, you can install it through the __Visual Studio Installer__ (preferred method) or by clicking on [download .NET SDK](https://aka.ms/dotnet-extensionpack-sdk).

To verify it's installed, [open a terminal](command:workbench.action.terminal.new) and try running the following command:

```
dotnet --version
```

You should see the version of the __.NET SDK__ that you have installed.
